# Urda Anvil

Urda Anvil is a collection of tools, settings, prompts, and software that Urda
uses to build software with LLMs. The anvil.urda.com site documents that
workbench. It lists the models on the anvil, the default MCP servers and their
tool permissions, and a set of bookmarks.

Forged Status Line is a two-row status line for Claude Code. The top row shows
the model and the modes. The bottom row shows gauges for context use and for
the 5-hour and 7-day rate limits. The renderer is a bash script that uses jq,
under the Apache 2.0 license.

## Links

- [Urda Anvil README](https://github.com/urda-anvil/urda-anvil.github.io/blob/master/README.md): How the anvil.urda.com site is built
- [urda-anvil/urda-anvil.github.io](https://github.com/urda-anvil/urda-anvil.github.io): Source for anvil.urda.com
- [urda/forged-statusline](https://github.com/urda/forged-statusline): Source for the Forged Status Line renderer
- [Forged Status Line](https://anvil.urda.com/forged-statusline/): Demo and gallery
